body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Ran an accessibility scan on {{domain}} and found {{total_issues}} elements with WCAG 2.1 AA violations that put the store at ADA Title III risk — the same issue set that triggered over 5,000 lawsuits against online retailers in 2025, with e-commerce being the #1 most-sued category.

Three most urgent on {{business_name}}:

1. {{top_issue_1}} — product pages without proper alt text or ARIA labels are the single most-litigated issue for online stores. Screen-reader shoppers (7M+ in the US) can't browse your catalog at all.

2. {{top_issue_2}} — an inaccessible checkout flow doesn't just create legal exposure, it actively loses you revenue. Studies show 71% of disabled users will abandon a purchase rather than report an issue.

3. {{top_issue_3}} — these structural failures also tank your SEO. Google's accessibility signals now directly impact Core Web Vitals and AI Overview rankings.

I can send {{business_name}} a free 17-point audit report (with copy-paste remediation code for your dev team). No strings. If you want us to handle the fixes: flat $1,200, done in 2 weeks.

Worth 15 minutes to see where you stand?

— Emilio Ranucoli
